observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment pytest, Python compileall, and Git diff checks

verified_behaviors: A scoped capability event group joins to a trace row only through the exact service execution identity and exposes that row's validated resource measurement.
An older trace without a resource sample remains readable and reports not-recorded-on-trace; malformed data is not accepted as a measurement.
Compact ECI responses retain a bounded CPU, RSS high-water growth, and storage read/write summary beside the exact execution identity under an 8 KB limit.
Partial measurements preserve partial status and explicit null counter fields rather than presenting missing counters as zero.
The selected-session service-readiness projection exposes resource-measurement status alongside its execution reference without duplicating the full counter record.
Compact service-accountability caveats are shortened without asserting fulfillment, receipt, burden reduction, or causality.

observation.scope_limit: The whole repository suite was not run; the 21 existing environment-dependent cases remained skipped. No resident owner tick was run in this slice.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Correlated ambient service activity does not expose owner resource costs
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability intelligence and ambient owner traces
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A trace resource sample must be correlated through the same exact execution identity as the service activity to be useful in the ECI projection.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain validated bounded resource evidence in full and compact ECI views while preserving explicit measurement limits.

measurement_limits: Regression verification proves deterministic joining, validation, and bounded projection behavior, not a live service cost or agent burden reduction.
The skipped cases depend on external repositories or executor capabilities not exercised by these targeted suites.
